description: This Java class manages background image pickers for a wearable notification application, allowing users to select and retrieve background images.

classes.name: BackgroundPickers
classes.description: Manages a collection of background image pickers, allowing generation, retrieval, and clearing of pickers, and notifies listeners on changes.

classes.name: BackgroundPickers.OnBackgroundPickersChangedListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to changes in background pickers.

methods.name: generatePickers
methods.description: Creates a specified number of background pickers dynamically.

methods.name: getRes
methods.description: Retrieves the resource ID of the background image at a given index.

methods.name: getRes
methods.description: Retrieves all background image resources managed by the pickers.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all pickers and clears the container.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of current pickers.
